scope: software/mission_studio only; current CAD/print files and physical commissioning firmware unchanged
cross_provider: No different-provider reviewer CLI available; local adversarial review completed.
independent_validation: All eight retained primary findings independently validated before implementing caller fixes.

resolved.title: Configured model delays conversational stop
resolved.caller_fix: Local imperative STOP bypasses inference and aborts the browser request.

resolved.title: Backward scrubbing leaves the future map on mission footage
resolved.caller_fix: Reset/import invalidate map, camera, audio and narration sampling clocks.

resolved.title: Project import leaves attachment controls out of sync
resolved.caller_fix: Attachment controls synchronize with actual restored parts.

resolved.title: Graphics loss leaves held-drive and scrub actions running
resolved.caller_fix: Graphics-loss cleanup cancels pending work and held drive; rendering checks lost context before GL calls.

resolved.title: Align rendered yaw with the controller heading
resolved.caller_fix: Body, radar, wheels and future heading use the simulator coordinate convention.

resolved.title: Require explicit movement commands and correct destinations
resolved.caller_fix: Explicit movement imperatives, word boundaries and home-before-marker routing.

resolved.title: Bind verification to the tested HTML response
resolved.caller_fix: Browser/video tools replay the exact verified server response bytes.

resolved.title: Failed video rerender can retain stale verification
resolved.caller_fix: Temporary video, successful probe, atomic publication and artifact-hash validation on packaging.

additional_fixes: Bounded optional model concurrency, explicit camera snapshot, recorder/speech cleanup, hidden-path optimization and edited-project/decoded-pixel coverage.
limits: No physical hardware, phone audio/camera, user GPU benchmark or actual installed-model inference was tested.
Camera detector is a rendered-pixel colour tracker and navigation starts from a known arena prior.
Flight is a scripted concept animation without aerodynamics.
